payload.title: [Figs. 3-4] LMRonline
payload.description: This notebook investigates the spectral properties of the LMRonline ensemble and reproduces Figures 3-4 from a related paper. It compares the online data assimilation (DA) ensemble with the offline DA by subsampling and applying spectral analysis techniques. The notebook uses various statistical methods to estimate autoregressive model parameters and visualize the results through plots.

steps.description: Load necessary libraries and the LMRonline ensemble data. Set up the initial plot for the ensemble.
steps.title: Initialize and Load Data

steps.description: Subsample the online DA ensemble to match the offline DA ensemble size. Apply spectral analysis using the multitaper method and perform anti-alias filtering.
steps.title: Subsample and Apply Spectral Analysis

steps.description: Estimate autoregressive model parameters using the AutoReg model from statsmodels.
steps.title: Estimate Autoregressive Model Parameters

steps.description: Export the estimated autoregressive model parameters to a CSV file.
steps.title: Export AR Model Parameters to CSV

dependencies: Export AR Model Parameters to CSV
steps.description: Create violin plots to visualize the autoregressive model parameters.
steps.title: Visualize AR Model Parameters with Violin Plots

steps.description: Perform autocovariance analysis and fit an exponential model to the autocovariance function.
steps.title: Autocovariance Analysis
